Visible board information

Field notes
Move the shepherd around a cohesive flock. Sheep repel away from you, separate from close neighbors and drift toward nearby companions. Every action advances one physical tick.
Whistle briefly expands your pressure radius but then cools for six ticks. Approach from outside the flock; forcing its center can scatter the group.
Pen seven of eight sheep through the right-edge opening. Two escapes beyond the field make the quota impossible and lose. Clear three paddocks with different gate and obstacle geometry.

Tap named controls. Focus the board for displayed keyboard shortcuts. Escape pauses. Every action is turn-paced. Retry this study preserves earlier clears; Restart all begins at study one.

Every simulation advances only when you act. Take your time. You can inspect the board before committing, and restart any study.

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Choose prefix branches based on eventual completion parity and forced terminal words. Challenge is a transparent correction for invalid extension, not credited as strategic bluff: a rational dictionary-checking rival always challenges it. Mixed odd/even branching must carry the depth alone.

Take a seat
How to play
Public finite dictionary of the complete familiar-word list shown by the prefix browser, always available. Alternate appending one letter to shared fragment; making a complete dictionary word of length at least four loses a life. May challenge rival previous prefix; if no dictionary extension exists rival loses life, otherwise challenger loses and shortest valid extension is revealed. Reset fragment after each life; alternate opener. Each new fragment offers three initial letters from rich, mixed-length dictionary branches. The chosen initial is retired for this entire match: neither player may reuse it. The offered initial tray varies by deal.
Reduce house from three lives to zero before own lives gone; challenge failure is natural loss path.
